description: Quality gate thresholds (authoritative source; read by the reporter skill). Keys use snake_case, matching quality-gate-policy.json.
_enforcement: The reporter gate enforces: minPassRate, maxCriticalFailures, maxTestDuration_ms, criticalTcPassRate. maxOpenP1Defects/maxOpenP2Defects are DEFERRED — they require JIRA open-defect counts the reporter does not query in v4 (see quality-gate-policy.json → thresholdEnforcement.deferred). They are kept here for a future release-gate/CI step, NOT applied by the reporter.
